{{Top|leg}}
The '''ramjet mining ship''' was a type of vehicle used for [[Mining/Legends|mining]].

The settlement on the [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Eol Sha]], in the dangerous [[Cauldron Nebula/Legends|Cauldron Nebula]] was set up by businessmen who used the ramjet mining ships to mine gases in the nebula.
